docs.title: Eat What Ah
docs.text: A lightweight food companion app for Android to help you log favorite spots and decide what to eat.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Quick Logging: Save favorite dishes, stalls, and restaurant spots.
  • Decision Assistant: Randomizer and filtering to break meal indecision.
  • Local Storage: Fast and private, keeping all your food notes directly on your device.

View Privacy Policy

docs.title: Privacy Policy — Eat What Ah
docs.text: Last Updated: 2026

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Eat What Ah operates locally on your device.

  • Data Collection: No personal details, analytics, or behavioral tracking are collected.
  • Storage: All saved entries remain stored on your local device.
  • Deletion: Uninstalling the app or clearing application cache removes all data.

Contact: support (at) blackpiranha.net

docs.title: Sparrowhawk
docs.text:
Enabling your doomscrolling in comfort and style[cite: 1]

A modern RSS reader for Android[cite: 1]. Built for readers who value simplicity, clean typography, and dedicated buttons to navigate between articles[cite: 1, 19].

docs.title: Why Sparrowhawk?
docs.text:
• 📖 Modern Reading Interface[cite: 1] Developed with a clean Material 3 interface[cite: 1]. Features dedicated navigation buttons between articles without needing to constantly flick or swipe across the screen[cite: 1, 19].

  • 🛠️ Powerful Management[cite: 1] Automated feed discovery—just paste a website URL[cite: 1]. Organize your sources with custom categories and full OPML import/export support[cite: 1, 3].

  • 🎨 Deep Customization[cite: 1] Material 3 design with dynamic colors, Light and Dark themes, and support for Google Fonts to personalize your reading typography[cite: 1, 3, 19].

  • 🧹 Privacy First[cite: 1] All data stays on your device[cite: 1]. Local Room database storage and foreground-only maintenance preserve your battery and privacy with no logins required[cite: 1, 2, 3].

  • ✨ Free![cite: 1] Use Sparrowhawk without limitations for free[cite: 1].

docs.title: Privacy Policy — Sparrowhawk
docs.text: Last Updated: May 17, 2026[cite: 2]

docs.title: Our Commitment
docs.text: Blackpiranha is committed to your privacy[cite: 2]. We believe that an RSS reader should be a personal tool, not a data collection instrument[cite: 2].

docs.title: Data Collection
docs.text:
Sparrowhawk does not collect or transmit any of your personal or sensitive user information to external servers.[cite: 2]

The app does not collect personal identifiers (such as name, email, or phone number), device identifiers, or location data[cite: 2]. All core data is handled exclusively on your device[cite: 2]:

  • Feed Subscriptions: URLs of the RSS/Atom feeds you follow[cite: 2].
  • Reading History: Articles read or bookmarked[cite: 2].
  • App Settings: Theme preferences, layout options, and typography configurations[cite: 2].

docs.title: Data Processing
docs.text: All data processing and article caching occurs locally on your device via a private Room database[cite: 2]. Direct network requests are made solely to fetch content from the feed providers you subscribe to, with no intermediary tracking servers[cite: 2].

docs.title: Data Deletion
docs.text: You retain complete control over your data[cite: 2]: * In-App: Delete individual feeds or wipe reading history inside the settings screen[cite: 2]. * System Settings: Clear storage at any time via Android Settings > Apps > Sparrowhawk > Storage > Clear Data[cite: 2]. * Uninstallation: Removing the application permanently deletes all local databases and cached records[cite: 2].

docs.title: Third-Party Services
docs.text: Sparrowhawk does not include any third-party analytics SDKs, trackers, or advertising frameworks[cite: 2].

docs.title: Contact
docs.text: Questions regarding this policy can be directed to: sparrowhawk.app (at) blackpiranha.net[cite: 2]

docs.title: Type Affair
docs.text: A font testing and typography inspection tool for Android.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Font Previews: Test heading and body pairings across various Google Fonts.
  • Type Scaling: Inspect dynamic sizes, weights, and letter-spacing tokens.
  • Material Design Ready: Evaluate typography behavior against Material 3 standards.

View Privacy Policy

docs.title: Privacy Policy — Type Affair
docs.text: Last Updated: 2026

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Type Affair does not track users or transmit personal data.

  • Network Usage: Network requests are limited strictly to downloading user-selected open font families from Google Fonts.
  • Local Settings: User preferences remain stored strictly within local device storage.

Contact: support (at) blackpiranha.net
